title: mir
description: Machine-readable description of an X Intrinsics (Xt) widget set, primarily Motif.

prefix.description: Toolkit prefix stripped from widget class names to derive widget keys.

include.description: Path to the header file that declares the widget class.

classSymbol.description: Raw widget class symbol name (e.g. xmPushButtonWidgetClass).

methods.description: Dictionary of methods associated with the widget, filtered to only those whose name starts with prefix + widget key (case-insensitive), keyed by method name with prefix and widget name stripped.

resources.description: Dictionary of resources for the widget class as returned by XtGetResourceList after XtInitializeWidgetClass, keyed by resource name.
